Draconic Bloodline.description: Your innate magic comes from draconic heritage, granting resilience, resistance, and elemental affinity.

1.name: Dragon Ancestor
1.tldr: Choose a type of dragon ancestor, granting language and damage interaction benefits.

1.name: Draconic Resilience
1.tldr: Your skin is covered in thin dragon scales, increasing your baseline AC and maximum hit points.

6.name: Elemental Affinity
6.tldr: Add your Charisma modifier to damage rolls of spells that match your dragon ancestor's damage type.

14.name: Dragon Wings
14.tldr: Grow a pair of draconic wings from your back, gaining a flying speed.

18.name: Draconic Presence
18.tldr: Channel the terrifying aura of a dragon to frighten or charm creatures around you.

Wild Magic.description: Your magic stems from the chaotic forces of chaos that leave unpredictable magical ripples in your wake.

1.name: Wild Magic Surge
1.tldr: Casting spells can trigger random, unpredictable surges of wild magic effects.

1.name: Tides of Chaos
1.tldr: Gain advantage on an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, and guarantee a wild magic surge on your next spell.

6.name: Bend Luck
6.tldr: Spend sorcery points to subtly manipulate fate, adding or subtracting from another creature's roll.

14.name: Controlled Chaos
14.tldr: Gain some control over your wild magic surges, rolling twice on the surge table and picking your preferred result.

18.name: Spell Bombardment
18.tldr: Roll an extra damage die when you deal damage with a spell, multiplying its chaotic destructive potential.
